metrics.name: descent_rate_ratio
metrics.notes: Holding mass, Cd, and altitude constant while doubling diameter quadruples area; terminal rate therefore scales by 1/2 in this model.

expected.notes: Metamorphic invariant of the browser terminal-descent implementation.

source.derivation: The browser model uses circular area proportional to diameter squared and terminal rate proportional to inverse square root of area.
source.notes: This invariant does not establish real-world parachute performance.

comparison.decisionRule: The transformed/base browser output ratio remains 0.5 within the stated analytic tolerance; this review case never gates agreement.

notes: Review-only metamorphic coverage; not accepted evidence.
